Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of right shoulder pain and limited range of
motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the injury pattern observed on examination. Over the course of
thirteen visits, care followed a conventional progression, beginning with immobilization, anti-inflammatory medication, and
graded physical therapy, and frequency of visits was reduced as symptoms improved. Examination documented reduced active
abziction and tenderness over the rotator cuff insertion, which support the diagnosis, while several other provocative and
neurovascular tests returned normal results. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder. Treatment
charges were billed once per service, with no duplicated or repeated entries. At discharge from active care, the patient had
reganied most functional motion and reported pain at a low level, with a home exercise program continued and follow-up
available as needed.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
